hits.about: Taking inspiration from the sublime Italian architectural heritage that has transcended both time and space, Sur La Mer by Meraas is the doorway to a new dimension of luxurious seafront living in the 21st century. Situated between the blue waters of the Arabian Gulf, the beautiful Port de La Mer, and the breathtaking La Mer beachfront, this residential paradise is slated to be the first-ever freehold townhouse community located in Jumeirah 1, which is hailed as one of the region’s most sophisticated districts.Seize the moment and indulge in European charm with a coastal appeal only at Sur La Mer in Dubai.A Haven of Beauty Inspired by Rich Italian Architectural HeritageHere at Sur La Mer in Jumeirah, the glory and sophistication of contemporary classic Italian architecture radiate at its finest. Each villa is distinguished by striking colour palettes and vibrant materials that emphasise genuine opulence. Featuring 3, 4, and 5-bedroom townhouses beautiful facades, and carefully planned details that appeal to your finer tastes, this is the ultimate destination where class and tranquillity give justice to a cosmopolitan lifestyle by the sea.Add to that the awe-inspiring views of the azure sea and the skyline, the community perfectly exudes a unique and warm character that you can never get enough of.Celebrate the Charm of European Seaside AmbienceBoasting a visually striking landscape comprising of greeneries, open spaces shaded by lemon and olive trees, and alleys beautifully covered in magenta Bougainville flowers, Sur La Mer emanates the spirit of European seaside atmosphere.What’s more, this upscale community gives you an everyday treat through its linear park along with other world-class amenities. Hence, there is no reason why you cannot fall in love with Sur La Mer Townhouses.Port de La Mer: Captivating Enchantress in the Heart of DubaiIdeally situated adjacent to the mesmerising Port de La Mer, Sur La Mer is a pioneering master community strategically positioned at the tip of the peninsula. Here, residents are provided with exclusive access to a host of exceptional dining, hospitality, entertainment, and shopping experiences along with convenience and leisure options.
